entries.original_title: Paper page - Has GPT-6-Astra Achieved Embodied Intelligence?
entries.subtitle: GPT-6-Astra performed well across 12 robotics benchmarks, but the paper reports real-world deployment gaps in demonstration cost and execution time.
entries.reject_reason: This is a third-party robotics paper listed by a model tracker, not research from a tracked entity.

entries.original_title: Paper page - BizBench: Unveiling Hidden Challenges in Deploying Long-Horizon Agents for Real-World Business
entries.subtitle: BizBench tests agents on 50 real-world payment tasks and finds frontier models often violate constraints, even when they partly meet goals.
entries.reject_reason: BizBench is third-party research listed by a tracker, despite evaluating models from tracked companies.

entries.original_title: Paper page - HexaShell: A Thin Harness for Exploring the Limits of VLM Agents as Robot Coding Agents
entries.subtitle: HexaShell uses vision and self-written tools to control a two-arm robot, with strong RoboDojo results but trouble on contact-heavy tasks.
entries.reject_reason: HexaShell is research by an untracked team, and its use of an OpenAI model does not make it OpenAI research.

entries.original_title: Paper page - Learning to Think and Explore in 3D World
entries.subtitle: ACT3D trains vision-language models to explore 3D spaces from single images, using question-based navigation to improve answer accuracy.
entries.reject_reason: ACT3D is university research listed by a tracker, not a research result from a tracked entity.

entries.original_title: Paper page - OpenMobile-2: Building Versatile Mobile Agents with Scalable Environments and App-Native Tools
entries.subtitle: OpenMobile-2 trains a mobile agent with simulated apps and open data, covering over 110 apps and nearly 12K interaction paths.
entries.reject_reason: OpenMobile-2 is a university team’s work, not a model launch or research result from a tracked company.

entries.original_title: Paper page - Into the Unknown: Benchmarking AI agents on open scientific research problems
entries.subtitle: The benchmark tested AI agents on open research problems, finding that none met expert standards and most made false or conflicting claims.
entries.reject_reason: This agent benchmark comes from external researchers rather than a tracked entity.

entries.original_title: Paper page - Pack Light, CarryOn: Building Object-Oriented Context for Long-Horizon Agents
entries.subtitle: CarryOn organizes agent context around reusable task objects instead of interaction histories, improving efficiency and performance on complex tests.
entries.reject_reason: CarryOn is third-party agent research that appears on a tracker’s paper page.

entries.original_title: Paper page - BridgeWAM: Bridging Video and Action Experts via Latent Bridge Queries
entries.subtitle: BridgeWAM separates video and action models with 32 latent queries to improve action prediction efficiency and generalization.
entries.reject_reason: BridgeWAM is third-party research listed by a tracker, not research from a tracked entity.

entries.original_title: Paper page - LiveMACE: Process-Aware Evaluation of LLM Agent Capabilities in Evolving Markets
entries.subtitle: LiveMACE tests persistent language-model agents in financial markets and uses decision records to show that outcomes can hide capability differences.
entries.reject_reason: LiveMACEBench is third-party research listed by a tracker, not work from a tracked entity.

entries.original_title: Paper page - Scene-Designer: Learning Design Intelligence for Agentic 3D Scene Generation
entries.subtitle: Scene-Designer trains agents to create and critique 3D indoor scenes, supported by the Scene-OTA-35K and Scene-OTC-15K datasets.
entries.reject_reason: Scene-Designer is research from an untracked group that appears on a tracker’s paper page.
